role.roleTitle: Data Quality Engineer, E-commerce Fulfilment Software

evidence.text: Owned merchant feed quality for the fulfilment platform for three years as the named owner in the data ownership register, deciding which feed validations were blocking for onboarding and signing off each validation release myself.
Built and maintained the feed validation service (Kotlin, deployed with the ingestion stack) and the per-merchant quality scorecards used by onboarding and support.
Led the monthly merchant data quality forum with the onboarding and support leads, deciding the quality thresholds for new merchant tiers and recording the decisions in the forum notes.

Coordinated validation changes with the onboarding and platform teams through the platform change process, recording that the platform team owned the ingestion stack and onboarding owned merchant communication while I owned the validations.
Responsibilities included feed quality ownership, blocking-validation decisions, validation-service development, scorecards and the quality forum over about three years.
